data.name: Koustubh
data.gender_notes: Koustubh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Koustubh is derived from the Sanskrit language and is composed of two words - 'Kou' meaning 'Lord' and 'Stubh' meaning 'Universe'. It is the name of a deity revered in Hindu mythology, often depicted as an embodiment of creation and sustenance. The name Koustubh carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Koustubh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Koustubh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Koustubh total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

In some texts, Lord Ganesha is also known as Koustubh, emphasizing his role as the ruler of the universe. The name is also used in Jainism for the 16th Tirthankara, Lord Shubhankhana.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Koustubh holds immense spiritual significance as it signifies the divine presence of the Creator and the Sustainer of the Universe.
